text.tspan: 8gent-code: gaps

text.font-family: Marker Felt, Comic Sans MS, Segoe Print, cursive
text.tspan: What the code on origin/main shows is missing, unwired or unverified. Each card names its file evidence. Nothing here is inferred from memory; every claim has a path.

text.font-family: Marker Felt, Comic Sans MS, Segoe Print, cursive
text.tspan: PLATFORMS AND DEPLOYMENT

text.tspan: NO TESTS

text.tspan: OUTPUTS NOBODY READS

text.tspan: DUPLICATE MOVING PARTS

text.font-family: Marker Felt, Comic Sans MS, Segoe Print, cursive

text.font-family: Marker Felt, Comic Sans MS, Segoe Print, cursive
text.tspan: G01 Android/Termux login service never run against real
termux-services (#4852)

text.font-family: Marker Felt, Comic Sans MS, Segoe Print, cursive
text.tspan: Since #4878 service.ts has an android platform (ServicePlatform, a
termux-services backend that writes a runit service under $PREFIX/var/service
and drives it with `sv`, and servicePlatform() which counts Termux as android),
and scripts/smoke-termux.sh starts `8gent daemon run` on Node in termux-docker,
checks GET /health, attaches over the WebSocket and stops it with SIGTERM, on a
release tag. What no job runs is `8gent daemon install` on a real
termux-services: the runit plan is unit-tested as data only
(service-android.test.ts).
Evidence: packages/daemon/service.ts:26 ; packages/daemon/service.ts:346-440 ;
packages/daemon/service.ts:576-598 ; packages/daemon/service-android.test.ts ;
scripts/smoke-termux.sh:125-166

text.font-family: Marker Felt, Comic Sans MS, Segoe Print, cursive
text.tspan: G02 Fly eight-vessel runs board-vessel, not the daemon

text.font-family: Marker Felt, Comic Sans MS, Segoe Print, cursive
text.tspan: The root fly.toml app `eight-vessel` builds the root Dockerfile whose CMD is
the board-vessel entrypoint (packages/board-vessel/vessel.ts). Nothing in the
repo starts packages/daemon/index.ts on Fly, so 'the daemon runs on Fly' is
unverified.
Evidence: fly.toml ; Dockerfile ; scripts/board-vessel/entrypoint.sh:51-54

text.font-family: Marker Felt, Comic Sans MS, Segoe Print, cursive
text.tspan: G05 Swift apps ship as unsigned zips and no job gates on
them

text.font-family: Marker Felt, Comic Sans MS, Segoe Print, cursive
text.tspan: Since #4885 the swift-apps job in release-binaries.yml builds
apps/8gent-computer and apps/lil-eight from the tag and attaches them as zips.
They carry no Developer ID signature and no notarization (only the ad-hoc
signature each build.sh applies), so macOS warns on first open, and a failed
Swift build does not hold the release back.
Evidence: .github/workflows/release-binaries.yml:481-515 ;
.github/workflows/swift-nightly.yml

text.font-family: Marker Felt, Comic Sans MS, Segoe Print, cursive
text.tspan: G16 g8way has no deploy unit in infra

text.font-family: Marker Felt, Comic Sans MS, Segoe Print, cursive
text.tspan: README says it runs on the Hetzner box behind Caddy, but docker-compose.yml and
infra/hetzner/systemd carry only the daemon and two Telegram bridges. How g8way
is deployed is not in the repo.
Evidence: packages/g8way/README.md ; infra/hetzner/docker-compose.yml

text.font-family: Marker Felt, Comic Sans MS, Segoe Print, cursive
text.tspan: G06 Dead or stub packages

text.font-family: Marker Felt, Comic Sans MS, Segoe Print, cursive
text.tspan: dreams holds one markdown file and no code. qdrant-client is stubs that throw
NotImplementedError. planner, channels, control-plane and 8dk have zero
importers in packages, apps, bin, scripts and tests (channels appears only in a
security fixture list).
Evidence: packages/dreams ; packages/qdrant-client/README.md ;
packages/planner/index.ts ; packages/channels/index.ts ;
packages/control-plane/index.ts ; packages/8dk/index.ts

text.font-family: Marker Felt, Comic Sans MS, Segoe Print, cursive
text.tspan: G07 packages/tools: 62 of 98 modules have no importer

text.font-family: Marker Felt, Comic Sans MS, Segoe Print, cursive
text.tspan: Static grep of every top-level packages/tools/*.ts: 62 are imported by nothing
(utility files such as crc32, bit-flags, moving-average, sqli-pattern-detector)
and 60 of those have no test either. Full list in
docs/architecture/evidence/tools-orphans.tsv.
Evidence: packages/tools/crc32.ts ; packages/tools/lru-cache.ts ;
docs/architecture/evidence/tools-orphans.tsv

text.font-family: Marker Felt, Comic Sans MS, Segoe Print, cursive
text.tspan: G08 Orphan files inside packages/eight

text.font-family: Marker Felt, Comic Sans MS, Segoe Print, cursive
text.tspan: No importer outside tests for any of the four. clui-bridge.ts bridges to
apps/clui, which does not exist on main.
Evidence: packages/eight/auto-commit.ts ; packages/eight/clui-bridge.ts ;
packages/eight/curriculum.ts ; packages/eight/external-editor.ts

text.font-family: Marker Felt, Comic Sans MS, Segoe Print, cursive
text.tspan: G09 Packages with source and zero tests

text.font-family: Marker Felt, Comic Sans MS, Segoe Print, cursive
text.tspan: auth (Clerk and GitHub token handling) and quarantine are the two that matter
for security; hands drives the desktop with cliclick and osascript.
Evidence: packages/auth ; packages/quarantine ; packages/registry ;
packages/hands ; packages/lsp ; packages/tasks ; packages/personality ;
packages/design-agent ; packages/planning ; packages/executor ; packages/i18n ;
packages/repo-context

text.font-family: Marker Felt, Comic Sans MS, Segoe Print, cursive
text.tspan: G10 threat-feed is manual and nothing in the repo schedules
it

text.font-family: Marker Felt, Comic Sans MS, Segoe Print, cursive
text.tspan: OSV and CISA KEV are queried only when someone runs the CLI. No workflow,
shipped cron entry or daemon job calls it (grep of .github, scripts, packages).
Since #4874 the daemon does read the reports in
~/.8gent/security/threat-feed/<date>/, but only after a person's own cron:shell
job finishes (wake-wiring.ts turns new hits into wake events), so the reader
exists and the schedule does not.
Evidence: packages/threat-feed/cli.ts ; packages/threat-feed/README.md ;
packages/daemon/wake-wiring.ts:246-253

text.font-family: Marker Felt, Comic Sans MS, Segoe Print, cursive
text.tspan: G11 Turn journal is written every turn, read only by a
script

text.font-family: Marker Felt, Comic Sans MS, Segoe Print, cursive
text.tspan: ~/.8gent/turns/<session>/<n>.json has one reader,
scripts/turn-review-replay.ts. No TUI view, daemon route or CLI subcommand
reads it.
Evidence: packages/eight/turn-journal.ts:59 ; scripts/turn-review-replay.ts

text.font-family: Marker Felt, Comic Sans MS, Segoe Print, cursive
text.tspan: G12 ~/.8gent/evidence has no writer in the repo

text.font-family: Marker Felt, Comic Sans MS, Segoe Print, cursive
text.tspan: The only mention in product code is a design-doc comment. Whatever fills the
directory on a dev machine is outside the repo, so nothing in the code can
promise it exists.
Evidence: apps/tui/src/components/IntroBanner.tsx:2

text.font-family: Marker Felt, Comic Sans MS, Segoe Print, cursive
text.tspan: G13 Two cron schedulers share one cron.json

text.font-family: Marker Felt, Comic Sans MS, Segoe Print, cursive
text.tspan: The CLI and TUI use packages/cron, the daemon uses packages/daemon/cron.ts,
both persist ~/.8gent/cron.json with their own code. Two writers, no shared
lock.
Evidence: packages/cron/index.ts:86 ; packages/daemon/cron.ts:36 ;
bin/8gent.ts:137

text.font-family: Marker Felt, Comic Sans MS, Segoe Print, cursive
text.tspan: G19 Four Telegram code paths

text.font-family: Marker Felt, Comic Sans MS, Segoe Print, cursive
text.tspan: Each talks to api.telegram.org with its own client. The Hetzner units run the
daemon bridge; the Fly app runs apps/8gent-bot; packages/telegram is imported
by agent.ts and repl.ts.
Evidence: packages/daemon/telegram-bridge.ts ; packages/telegram-bot/index.ts ;
packages/telegram/index.ts ; apps/8gent-bot/src/index.ts

text.font-family: Marker Felt, Comic Sans MS, Segoe Print, cursive
text.tspan: G14 Convex backend is not in this repo

text.font-family: Marker Felt, Comic Sans MS, Segoe Print, cursive
text.tspan: apps/convex holds only _generated files. packages/db runs offline without
CONVEX_URL. The schema and functions it talks to live elsewhere, so the sync
path cannot be read here.
Evidence: apps/convex/_generated/api.ts ; packages/db/client.ts:63

text.font-family: Marker Felt, Comic Sans MS, Segoe Print, cursive
text.tspan: G17 '8gate' is not a module; 8J is opt-in behind g8way

text.font-family: Marker Felt, Comic Sans MS, Segoe Print, cursive
text.tspan: The name 8gate appears only in tests and test comments (provider-choice,
model-routed-event, redirect, guard-rules-gaps), as an Ollama model tag or a
judge nickname. The shipped judge is Selene-1-Mini via packages/decide, on by
default. 8J (HF Space 8GI/8j-eval) is reachable only through a g8way upstream
with EIGHT_ALLOW_HOSTED=1.
Evidence: packages/eight/provider-choice.test.ts ;
packages/g8way/README.md:50-75 ; packages/decide/README.md:299-303

text.font-family: Marker Felt, Comic Sans MS, Segoe Print, cursive
text.tspan: G18 Stub web apps: root src/ and apps/debugger

text.font-family: Marker Felt, Comic Sans MS, Segoe Print, cursive
text.tspan: The root `dev` script runs next dev over a three-file stub. apps/debugger's
README is the create-next-app default, so its purpose is not stated in the
repo.
Evidence: src/Counter.tsx ; src/app/icon.tsx ; apps/debugger/README.md ;
package.json (dev: next dev)

text.font-family: Marker Felt, Comic Sans MS, Segoe Print, cursive
text.tspan: G15 Docs name apps and counts the tree does not have

text.font-family: Marker Felt, Comic Sans MS, Segoe Print, cursive
text.tspan: README.md and CLAUDE.md list apps/clui and apps/dashboard, neither exists.
CLAUDE.md says 11 providers and 'Apple Foundation is NOT wired'; the registry
holds 20 entries and apple-foundation is wired (index.ts:340).
Evidence: README.md:608-609 ; CLAUDE.md:21-22 ;
packages/providers/index.ts:274-577
